IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/9] Eighty out of 94 young people who were allocated to SPARX returned questionnaires reporting number of modules completed. Adherence rates for SPARX were good, with 69 (86%) of participants allocated to SPARX completing at least four modules, 48 (60%) completing all seven modules, and 50 (62%) completing most or all of the homework challenges set.
IPT.warning: SPARX is a computerized intervention, not explicitly named IPT or interpersonal therapy, thus coded as CBT (0).

Source.warning: The measures mentioned (number of modules completed, homework challenges set) are adherence measures, not psychological constructs (mediators or outcomes) for which Source is typically extracted in this MA.
